articleTitle: Optimization of operating strategy for smooth operation of heavy haul train
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: To address the difficulty of train operating on the long steep down-slopes, this paper proposes an optimization method of operating strategy for smooth operation of heavy haul train. Taking the practical operational regulations of heavy haul train into consideration, an optimization model of smooth operation is established with the optimization objective of minimizing the in-train force. Then, the multi-population strengthen elitist genetic algorithm with opposition-based learning initialization strategy (MSEGA-OBL) is proposed to solve the optimization problem of operating strategy. Based on the actual field data of Shuohuang railway, the simulation experiments are carried out to obtain the optimal driving curve. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition Based on Lightweight 3D MobileNet-v2 and Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Sign language is the primary communication medium for deaf-mute people, including gestures, facial expressions, and body postures. Sign language recognition (SLR) aims to recognize the sign video into the word or sentence and promote communication between ordinary people and deaf people. Recently, due to the development of deep learning, deep neural networks, especially 3D convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have been widely used in SLR. In this paper, we seek efficient spatiotemporal modeling for SLR. Specifically, we first build the efficient 3D CNNs, i.e., 3D MobileNet-v2 for isolated SLR, and further enhance the performance by designing a random knowledge distillation strategy (RKD) to transfer the knowledge from multiple teacher models including R3D, R(2+1)D, and SlowFast networks. We also apply these lightweight models as spatiotemporal feature extractors in the Transformer framework for the more challenging continuous SLR. In the experiments, the distilled models show high efficiency and strong performance on the SLR-500 and CSL benchmarks. We conclude that the lightweight 3D MobileNet-v2 with the proposed RKD can achieve a balance between accuracy and efficiency and is very suitable for SLR.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain Technology Based Energy Trading Architecture Model
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Blockchain technology, the underlying technology of Bitcoin, has the characteristics of fairness, transparency and decentralization. These features can enable its participation in energy trading in the context of energy internet. In this paper, we first analyze the transaction characteristics under the traditional energy trading structure and analyze the difficulties faced in implementing the new energy trading method; then, we design a 3-tier energy trading structure based on blockchain based on existing research and analysis; finally, we introduce a weakly centralized management method to improve the trading level.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Technology and Development
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In the trend of decarbonization worldwide, the two-way communication smart grid is different from the traditional grid which was developed in one-way. The concept of renewable energy generation, intelligent monitoring and analysis feedback are added to make sure the grid system more environmentally friendly, efficient, and controllable. In this article, we will discuss the history and policies of smart grid development in different countries and what will be discussed next are the power generation, transmission, and distribution modes of the smart grid system, and two types of smart grid applications: nano-grid and micro-grid will also be explored. However, what cannot be ensured is how much economical the smart grid can save, and its network security still needs to be improved gradually. This article will provide readers with a deeper understanding of the history and policies of smart grid development, system architecture, and key applications, as well as present the challenges of the existing smart grid. Ultimately, the vigorous development of the smart grid can promote the intelligence of the modern grid, the penetration of clean energy, and have the use of improving the efficiency of electricity consumption significantly.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Algorithm Visualization Platform Based on Proxy Pattern
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, computer technology has become more and more popular. As we all know, algorithms play an important role in computer technology. Many Internet enterprises will examine the algorithm level of the interviewees when interviewing talents. People with good algorithm skills can use clever algorithms to improve the performance of programs. Our products are committed to transforming boring algorithms into comfortable animations for algorithm learners to watch, so as to help learners complete algorithm learning efficiently. This paper will be divided into three parts. The first part will introduce the technical architecture used by our product, the second part will introduce each module of our product, which part will explain the implementation ideas and implementation details of our product in detail, and the third part will show the pictures of our product.

articleTitle: Bee colony flow monitoring system based on SSD algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to reduce the labor cost in the process of beekeeping, this paper designed a colony flow monitoring system based on SSD algorithm. Using a one-way multi-frame detector SSD combined with The Faster R-CNN anchors for traffic detection, we have been trained with a high degree of accuracy using the model. Then the Web back-end data analysis platform is designed and built, and the system performance is optimized by Redis. By analyzing the flow data of bees in and out the living status of bee colony is given to achieve the purpose of intelligent monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on the Process-based Generation Method of Scenarios Database for Maritime Autonomous Surface Ship Test
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In recent years, Maritime Autonomous Surface Ship (MASS) has been developed rapidly and has demonstrated many new capabilities, which poses a challenge to the testing methods of autonomous ships. Currently, traditional test methods is no longer sufficient to support comprehensive testing and verification. For virtual testing, there is still a lack of a reliable virtual test scenario generation process. Therefore, this paper proposes a method for generating virtual test scenarios for autonomous ships. It is based on the scenario generation frame of the intelligent car and comprehensively considers the feature of the operating environment of the MASS. This process develops an element database by deconstructing the real scenes. For generating, it reconstructs and assigns the elements according to the test task (functional scenario) and the logical relationship between the elements (logical scenario) to reconstruct the new scenario. The new scenarios obtained in this way are optimized and supplemented to be the test scenarios database. In addition, a prototype following this frame was designed and loaded with the "automatic pathfinding task of the Wuhan section of the Yangtze River under good navigation conditions" for testing. The experiment generated 48 different scenarios, proving that this generator can output a comprehensive test scenario database to meet test requirements.

articleTitle: Attention-based CNN and BiLSTM hybrid Model for Aspect-level Sentiment Classification
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis(ABSA) is an important task in the field of text classification to analyze the subjective information of texts. Most existing ABSA models ignore the importance of represent the aspect and context separately and only use a single type of neural network to represent aspect and context. The most used are convolutional neural network(CNN) and Long Short-Term Model(LSTM). CNN can effectively extract phrase-level features, but it is easy to ignore the contextual relevance of the text. LSTM can capture the global structure information of the text, but it has insufficient ability to distill the key information. Considering different feature analysis demands of context and aspect, We use their different characteristics to propose a model based on them and attention, which is more accurate and efficient. CNN is used to extract the feature of aspect words, and it is fused with processed by Bi-LSTM. The attention mechanism captures the sentiment information of aspect and context. This process improves the accuracy of sentiment classification. The experiments conducted on SemEval 2014 task4 datasets(Li et al. 2015; Tang, Qin, and Liu 2015) (Pontiki et al., 2014) demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our model.

articleTitle: Image Stitching based on an Improved SIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high dimension and poor real-time performance of SIFT algorithm in the process of image stitching, a new stitching algorithm is proposed based on SIFT algorithm. Firstly, SVD algorithm is proposed to reduce the feature dimension to improve the running speed. Secondly, KD-Tree algorithm is used to match feature points based on Euclidean distance, and a bidirectional matching strategy is proposed to determine the parameters of proportional threshold to improve the accuracy of feature point matching. Finally, bilinear interpolation fusion algorithm is used to realize image stitching. Experimental results show that the proposed method further improves the image stitching speed on the basis of ensuring the image stitching quality.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation of Light Field Sub-aperture Images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Light field images (LFIs) has emerged as a new technology allowing to capture richer visual information from our world. However, the LFIs will meet different degrees of distortion during transmission and imaging display. An effective light field image quality assessment (IQA) index is necessary for the development and application of the light field. We propose a deep learning method based on light field sub-aperture images (SAIs) to solve the problem of quality evaluation of LFIs, called SAIs hyper-IQA Net, it adopts hyper-IQA as backbone network to extract features and the sub-aperture images are used as the input of hyper-IQA according to the image stacks in four different directions. Finally, the feature vectors are combined together for the regression of the final quality score through a fully connected layer. Our proposed model shows that the result has a good consistency with human visual system (HVS) when comparing with existing metrics.

articleTitle: Optimization design of FSAE Racing steering disconnect point based on Adams
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Steering system is one of the most important subsystems in FSAE racing car. The driver directly controls the movement of the car, and its performance directly affects the performance of the car in driving. At the same time, in the jump of the suspension structure, it will lead to the change of the toe Angle. If the change range of the toe Angle is too large, it will affect the steering and stability of the vehicle. Taking Wuhan University of Technology Blade racing Car as the object, this paper studies the optimization process and method of Steering trapezoid of FSAE racing Car, establishes a virtual model, uses Adams/Car and Adams/Insight to carry out parametric simulation analysis and optimization, improves the relationship between the variation range of runout front beam and the Angle of left and right wheels, and finally determines the parameters of the steering mechanism breaking point. The steering system optimization scheme with improved performance is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Reform of "Tunnel Engineering Construction" Course Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the continuous development of information teaching, the traditional and single teaching mode can no longer meet the teaching needs. In order to improve the teaching level and cultivate high-tech and high-skilled talents that meet the needs of the society, it is necessary to continuously carry out teaching innovations and reforms. Higher vocational students have a weak foundation, lack of interest in learning tunnel engineering construction, and fail to realize the importance of tunnel engineering construction courses to their professions. Based on many years of teaching experience, in view of the current teaching status of tunnel engineering construction courses in higher vocational colleges, a teaching reform method based on BIM technology to promote tunnel engineering construction courses in higher vocational colleges is proposed. Incorporate BIM theory into the teaching of tunnel engineering for municipal engineering technology students, guide students to learn BIM software independently, and better serve the study of tunnel engineering construction courses with BIM theory. Student performance has been significantly improved, which greatly increases the number of vocational students learning tunnels. Interest in engineering construction, teaching effect is good. At the same time, the teaching quality of tunnel engineering construction courses in higher vocational schools has been improved, and the employment competitiveness of higher vocational students has been improved.

articleTitle: System operation and data value application of energy big data center based on dual-carbon theory
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In 2020, China announced to the world the national goal of achieving a carbon peak by 2030 and striving to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060, and put forward a phased goal for China's green and low-carbon transition of energy. Energy big data is a vital data information asset. Mining the value of the data behind it is an important starting point to help achieve the goal of carbon peak and carbon neutrality. Based on the background of achieving the dual-carbon goal, this paper uses electricity data as the core data to analyze the general situation and current energy big data center construction situation. And the system operation ideas of the energy big data center and the appropriate data value application mode are explored to promote the utilization efficiency of energy big data as well as the development of new business forms and new models of energy big data centers, and facilitate the transformation and upgrading of the energy industry.

articleTitle: Resampled importance sampled stochastic lightcuts
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Scenes with many dynamic lights exist in various industries, and rendering which with ray tracing in real time remains a challenging problem. In this paper, we extend the real-time stochastic lightcuts method to achieve better performance. The key idea is to sample lights by resampling instead of traversing light tree. To make a good balance between rendering quality and performance when resampling, we also propose a metric to measure lighting contribution. Experiments show that our approach generates comparable effects to the real-time stochastic lightcuts method and achieves significant performance improvement at the cost of modest rendering quality loss.

articleTitle: Study on agricultural soil and water conservation based on analytic hierarchy process model
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The water and soil environment of irrigation area plays a very important role in the regional ecological environment, especially the groundwater level, river ecological flow, water quality and total water consumption, which will cause a series of ecological environmental problems. Therefore, based on the research of ecological irrigation area, constructing an evaluation model of water and soil environment in irrigation area is of certain significance to explore the problems of water and soil environment in irrigation area. Combined with the actual situation of the irrigation area, this paper applies the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to comprehensively evaluate the water and soil environment of the irrigation area, uses the analytic hierarchy process to determine the weight of the evaluation index. The research content of this paper is helpful to the construction of water ecological health system in irrigation area. It can improve the utilization coefficient of irrigation water and the assurance rate of ecological water demand, reduce the exploitation of groundwater and the use of chemical fertilizer, supplement the short board of ecological environment in irrigation area, and make the water and soil environment in irrigation area more healthy.

articleTitle: Research on Fine-Grained Classification Scheme Based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Fine-grained image classification is to identify the general category of objects by means of fine-grained classification, but it is extremely difficult to determine the names of objects in a more refined way. The biggest challenge is that the visual differences between different categories under the same broad category are extremely small. Therefore, the image resolution required for finer classification is high. Based on this, this paper designs a novel end-to-end image fineclassification network that can focus on the spatial features of images by considering the textual and visual features of images while introducing a spatial attention mechanism, and our approach achieves good results on both Con-text and Bottles datasets. In addition, we also introduce graph neural networks for cross-modal inference, and use adaptive graph convolutional neural networks to learn a richer set of visual features and to model a more discriminative semantic space, enabling fine-grained image classification based on scene text. This research is of great importance for the long-term development of the field.

articleTitle: Overview of Research on Code Annotation Evolution and Classification
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Code comments are an integral part of the software source code, which contains low-level information about the functions of the software source code, usually a brief description of the programmer's assumptions and intentions, and is an effective way to assist related software developers in understanding the software source code.As an extended branch of program understanding, code comments are even more important in the fields of software development, maintenance, refactoring, reuse, and reverse engineering. In order to make better use of code comments and give full play to their role, it is necessary to deeply understand code comments, analyze the development of code comments and the purpose of adding comments by software programmers, and explore the co-evolutionary relationship between code comments and source code. The different uses of code comments, summarize the evolution and classification of source code comments, and analyze its related methods, and put forward the current problems and future directions in this research field through sorting and summarizing.

articleTitle: Demand analysis of the application of intelligence push based on artificial intelligence in the military field
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In modern warfare, battlefield intelligence information has exploded. How to actively and effectively guide commanders to obtain the most needed and more timely and accurate battlefield intelligence resources in the shortest time has become a realistic and urgent problem. This article focuses on this topic, proposes intelligence push based on artificial intelligence technology, analyzes the status and development trend of push technology, and aims at the problem that intelligence retrieval cannot meet the individual needs of combat users and intelligence customization cannot tap the potential needs of combat users. It demonstrates the unique technical advantages of intelligence push based on artificial intelligence technology, such as individualization, real-time, and intelligence, and summarizes the practical significance of intelligence push in the military field.

articleTitle: Research on Lane Detection Method based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The reliability of lane detection directly affects the safety of intelligent vehicles in the process of assisted driving or even unmanned driving. In this paper, three different lane detection algorithms are compared and analyzed, and their detection effects are verified. At present, the mainstream lane detection methods are divided into traditional detection methods based on machine learning and deep learning. Deep learning has more advantages in applicability and reliability than machine learning. In recent years, deep learning has made great progress in vision, and a large number of detection methods have emerged, which has achieved better results than machine learning when applied to lane line detection. In order to clearly display the performance of various detection methods, this paper studies and compares the three semantic segmentation networks U-net, Deeplabv3+ and PSPnet with the help of miou, the mainstream evaluation index. Guide researchers to better choose lane line detection network. Experiments show that Deeplabv3+ network has better detection accuracy than other networks in lane line detection, and also has a good effect in the face of complex scenes.

articleTitle: Refined Single Shot Text Detector with Cascaded Regression in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel method call Refine Single Shot Text Detector (RSSTD) for arbitrary-oriented text detection in complex environments. The model consists two inter-connected modules called coarse detection module (CDM) and fine detection module (FDM). The CDM performs negative anchor filtering to provide better initialization for the FDM, in which the accurate text boxes are regressed based on the refined anchors. This results in a end -to-end trained model that essentially works in a coarse-to-fine manner. Meanwhile, we utilize a pixel IoU (PIoU) loss which is well-suited for oriented boxes. The proposed method is evaluated on two public datasets, namely ICDAR 2013 and 2015. Experimental results demonstrate its superiority over several state-of-the-art bounding box-based approaches.

articleTitle: Non-invasive electrical appliance analysis and identification device
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: This device develops a non-intrusive method to monitor the usage of home appliances which is based on STM32F407. It is mainly composed of power supply circuit, sampling circuit, signal conditioning circuit, A/D conversion circuit and microcontroller circuit. The current signal output by the power frequency current transformer is amplified by the INA188 module and sampled by the AD7606 module. Then it uses Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm to get the current waveform spectrum. The current signal harmonics are used as the optimal characteristic parameters for load identification, and the minimum Euclidean distance is used as the optimization index. By enumerating the combination of all electrical appliances, the similarity coefficient between the electrical appliances and a certain combination is calculated. From this, the type of electrical appliance is derived. The working current of the device is less than 15 mA and the response time is less than 2 s. In general, the recognition accuracy rate is about 95.5% after 600 tests.

articleTitle: Research on power balance of multi-motor drive for mining belt transportation
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In view of the uneven load distribution of the multi-drive motors, the overload operation causes the motor windings to overheat, resulting in insulation reduction or even burnout, and the power waste caused by the low efficiency of underload operation. This paper proposes a combined control method of master-slave control method and current average value control method to realize multi-motor drive power balance adjustment for mining belt transportation. Analyze the power balance between the motors in the drive system of the large and long-distance belt transmission system with multiple drive motors, and compare the main methods of power balance adjustment, combining the actual situation with the improved current average control method and the master-slave control method. The method to adjust the power balance. This paper takes the copper mine dumping and transportation system as the research object, and aims at saving energy and improving production efficiency and economic benefits. The designed multi-motor-driven mining belt transmission system based on PLC control basically achieves the expected effect.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Question Answering System in Smart Community
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In recent years, the construction of smart communities has been in full swing. However, at present, the overall framework of smart community is still lacking in innovative and user-friendly design. In order to solve the problem, we have developed an intelligent question answering system that can look after the elderly, serve residents and improve the efficiency of community management. The core algorithm of our system is composed of two modules of question answering matching and emotion analysis. The question answering matching module has great advantages over the small-scale domain specific corpus, and the extended question matching database can match user questions comprehensively and accurately, which improves the accuracy of intelligent question answering system. The sentiment analysis module reasonably models the speaker's emotion dynamic rules and establishes a timing analysis and processing mechanism, which has high efficiency and can effectively judge the psychological state of the elderly and timely feedback, greatly improving the quality of community care service.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Experimental Training Platform for Programming Courses Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Practical teaching in higher vocational colleges is an important part in the teaching of programming courses. In order to strengthen the experimental training management, improve students' learning enthusiasm, and further optimize the practical teaching design, an experimental training platform of the course is constructed. The experimental projects are designed based on the software life cycle and the enterprise standard project development process. Practice has proved that the use of the platform will become an important support for practical teaching. Through the implementation of big data analysis and evaluation of training results, students' teamwork ability and practice level have been further improved.

articleTitle: Research on technology and method of atmospheric environment audit based on GIS
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: GIS technology is mostly used in the physical evaluation of land resources and water resources in natural resources and environmental audit. However, the atmospheric environment has distinct geographical and spatial distribution characteristics, and the current audit technology can not fit its characteristics well, so it can not fully play the supervision role of audit. In order to better improve the efficiency of atmospheric environment audit, strengthen the innovation and application of audit technology, and promote the smooth realization of the goal of air pollution prevention and control, this paper analyzes the feasibility of applying GIS to atmospheric environment audit, embeds the key technology of GIS into each stage of audit, and constructs the atmospheric environment audit framework based on GIS technology. The results of air pollution prevention and control are analyzed and evaluated in order to promote the development and innovation of air environment audit practice technology.

articleTitle: Research on the Case Handling System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: According to the actual work of an organ in District A, after fully considering the needs of grass-roots staff, a reliable, verifiable, and traceable optimization solution is proposed reduces the risk brought by the centralized management mode, and provides a new solution strategy for the traditional case handling system.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Directivity Study Based on Sensor Arrays
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Directional sound source is a new type of sound propagation method that uses the nonlinear effect of sound waves propagating in the air to produce highly directional audible sound, compared with the old diffusion type loudspeaker, not only can directionally spread the sound, and the sound beam is concentrated to spread farther, because of good reflectivity, can also be used to produce special sound effects such as virtual sound source, surround sound field. In the field of public security, armed police, maritime surveillance and fishery administration, military, airport to drive birds, civil disaster relief departments, border control and other fields have a wide range of application prospects. This paper analyzes the theoretical basis of the directional sound source, introduces the relevant background and origin of the acoustic parametric array, solves the Berktay far-field solution, the Westervelt acoustic parametric array, and the KZK equation, analyzes the ultrasonic properties, points out that the key to the directional sound source is the nonlinear characteristics of the medium, and builds the ultrasonic sensor calculation array by MATLAB, and studies the different factors on the ultrasonic wave directivity.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of 5G Network Slicing Technology in Power Tunnels
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The new application scenario of 5G network brings the need for service slice isolation, as well as bearer requirements such as large traffic and low latency. Among them, network function virtualization (Network Functions Virtualization, NFV), Provides a complete solution to meet flexible network deployment and efficient resource integration, virtual resource allocation through the implementation of service function chain (Service Function Chain, SFC) deployment implementation of. Based on the development status of 5G technology and smart grid and the future needs of new power service terminals, this paper analyzes the requirements for effective isolation of slicing in smart grids, meets the needs of special industries for network authentication and security, and achieves effective network isolation and step-by-step. Authentication is an effective application mode that satisfies the dynamic allocation of network resources under different load scenarios, and provides a reference solution for the intelligent construction of power tunnels.

articleTitle: Effect of welding current and welding time on nugget size in RSW
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Resistance spot welding (RSW) is a welding method using resistance heat as energy, which is widely used in vehicle welding technology. It includes the interaction between electricity, heat, magnetism and metallurgy. The quality of solder joints directly determines the safety and service life of the whole vehicle. In order to study the quality of nugget, this paper establishes a thermoelectric coupling shaft model based on ABAQUS software to study the influence of welding time and welding current on nugget size. Finally, it is concluded that the influence of welding current on nugget size is greater than welding time, and false welding will occur when both welding current and welding time are insufficient, Finally, the analysis was verified by metallographic reality. The research results can provide scientific basis for welding process parameters and vehicle welding inspection.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction of investor sentiment on stock market volatility
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The application of deep learning model in the financial field has attracted the attention of many researchers in recent years. This paper uses Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network model to study the relationship between investor sentiment and Volatility Prediction of Shanghai Stock Exchange index. The results show that during the sample observation period, there is a significant negative correlation between investor sentiment and stock market volatility, and investor sentiment can effectively predict the stock market volatility trend. These findings show that investor sentiment is closely related to the performance of the stock market, and investor sentiment has a significant impact on the stock market.

articleTitle: Research on urban gas load forecasting based on Bi-GRU model
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The prospective prediction of urban gas users' gas load is of great significance to guarantee the city's stable, safe and reliable gas use. Aiming at the difficulty of gas load prediction and the failure of LSTM network model to make full use of gas load data information. In this paper, Bi-GRU model is firstly constructed for feature learning. Secondly, multiple Bi-GRU network structures are superimposed together to build Stacked-Bi-GRU structure. Finally, the prediction of future gas load value is realized. The experimental results show that the gas load model proposed in this paper has higher prediction accuracy, which verifies the effectiveness of Bi-GRU model in the research field of gas load prediction.

articleTitle: Classification and diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease based on multimodal data
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is an irreversible neurodegenerative disease, and exploring early diagnostic methods can benefit patients in obtaining accurate and effective treatment. This study adopted multimodal data of clinical neuropsychological examinations and functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging brain network properties constructed by graph theory. Scales, global brain network properties and local properties with significant differences were used as features in patients with Alzheimer's disease, patients with mild cognitive impairment, and normal elderly people. The feature significances were analyzed, and three features and feature combinations calculated using Support Vector Machine and Naive Bayes Classifiers were compared. The results indicated that the scales and local brain network properties had better classification effects in the diagnosis, and the trichotomous classification accuracy of the two classifiers for all feature combinations was 85.07% and 88.06%, respectively. The feature selection method proposed in this paper has an auxiliary effect on the classification diagnosis.

articleTitle: Special Vehicle Anti-touch High-voltage Line Monitoring & Early Warning Device System Platform
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the continuous development of domestic social economy and scientific & technological productivity, people become increasingly demanding on the living standards and happiness. The power interruption caused by power construction not only causes people's hardship, but also leads to serious losses in power equipment and social economy. On this basis, this paper designs and constructs a set of special vehicle anti-touch high-voltage line monitoring & early warning system through sensor signal collection, SCM transmission module, wireless acceptance mode, monitoring & early warning module and user system information module. At the same time, different module accessories are explained, which is convenient for users to master the monitoring & early warning process. It is expected to bring scientific basis for the construction and operation of special vehicles in the electric power industry, and to reduce the generation rate of safety accidents.

articleTitle: Migration strategy of edge computing tasks based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Edge computing is to migrate terminal tasks to the edge server for execution, and reduce task execution delay and terminal energy consumption through reasonable migration decision. In view of the fact that a large number of literatures ignore the balance of computing tasks between servers, a multi-task multi-server joint optimization strategy based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed. Taking the delay and energy consumption as the optimization objectives, and considering the queuing delay and the balance of the amount of computation of the edge computing server (MEC). Simulation results show that, compared with other algorithms, the average task cost of the proposed algorithm based on Particle Swarm Optimization is the smallest, and the idle MEC server can be fully utilized.

articleTitle: Design of the Control System of the Two-wheeled balancing Vehicle Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to solve the complexity of the control system of the two-wheel balancing vehicle. A Two-wheeled balancing vehicle based on the DE10-Nano development board as the main controller is designed to cope with the instability of the two-wheeled vehicle control system operation. The MPU6050 sensor is used to detect the attitude of the Two-wheeled balancing vehicle. Due to the noise interference and random drift errors in the measurement of gyroscopes and accelerometers, the Kalman filter algorithm is utilized to fuse the collected data with the attitude to obtain the optimal attitude angle. The double closed-loop feedback network is formed by the optimal attitude angle and the motor speed fed back by the encoder, and the balance control of the Two-wheeled balancing vehicle is realized through the double closed-loop PID control algorithm. Finally, OPENMV4 is used to identify the front information of the Two-wheeled balancing vehicle, so as to control the motion state of the Two-wheeled balancing vehicle through the identified information. In this regard, the feasibility and effectiveness of the system are verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Offloading Strategy Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The traditional edge computing offloading strategy is difficult to achieve the long-term efficiency of the system, and the offload strategy based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is easy to converge to the local optimal solution. In order to solve the above problems, an edge computing offloading strategy based on DRL with entropy is designed. The information entropy is added to the value and strategy network update function. So, the agent needs to maximize the entropy While ensuring the maximum reward, which will improve the exploration ability of the agent. The results of the experiment show that the proposed offloading strategy TO-DRL has increased comprehensive efficiency by 12.09% compared with the EOC and increased by 3.93% compared with the TO-DRL without entropy, which effectively balances the delay and energy consumption of the system.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sine Cosine Aptimization Algorithm Based On S-type Function
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The Sine Cosine Algorithm is a new type of swarm intelligence algorithm. Aiming at the shortcomings of standard sine cosine algorithm, adaptive sine cosine aptimization algorithm based on S-type function (SCASF) is proposed. Utilizing the characteristics of S-type functions, the nonlinear adjustment of parameters is realized, and dynamic inertia weights are introduced to better balance the global search ability and local development ability of the algorithm. The results of simulation experiments on multiple classic test functions indicate that compared with the standard sine cosine algorithm and genetic algorithm, the SCASF algorithm has a significant improvement in the convergence speed and the convergence accuracy.

articleTitle: Online Ortho-rectification and Mosaic of UAV aerial imagery for emergency remote sensing
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Toward timely response to natural disasters, an photogrametry processing system based on ARM+GPU architecture of the HiSilicon embedded platform is established, so as to Ortho-rectify and mosaic UAV images online. More Specifically, ARM is responsible for data reception and storage, and GPU is responsible for data processing. By making full use of the GPU parallel structure and adopting the optimization of execution configuration, the processing efficiency of UAV images is greatly improved. The experimental results show that, for UAV image with a GSD of 0.05 meters and resolution of 6000*4000 pixels, the cost time of orthorectification can reach less than 0.1 seconds per image. Established photogrametry processing system also has obvious advantages in terms of volume, power consumption, real-time performance, and system stability.

articleTitle: Public opinion propagation model and simulation based on Impact model and improved SIR
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the development of the self-media industry, the information received by users become complex and diverse, but at the same time the problem of rumors has become more serious. Considering that public opinion is often accompanied by positive and negative information, and that different fields are often dominated by opinion leaders, the author proposes a Susceptible Clarify Infected Recovered (SCIR) model of the influence of opinion leaders in the field of positive and negative news communication based on the classic Susceptible Infected Recovered (SIR) model. Moreover, this model is based on the characteristics of the subject and uses the principle of system dynamics to simulate the various factors affecting the spread of public opinion. The simulation results show that this model is more consistent with the actual public opinion dissemination process than the SIR model. As a result, a control experiment is conducted to analyze the process of public opinion communication through simulation experiments and provide theoretical suggestions for positive news dissemination leaders.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Science and Technology Novelty Search Project Management System Based on SSJ Architecture
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to improve the work efficiency of science and technology novelty search projects and standardize the management workflow of novelty search projects, a science and technology novelty search project management system based on SSJ architecture was built, which realized the networking and intellectualization of science and technology novelty search project management. The system function included user registration and login, online filling or uploading the novelty search project power of attorney, project acceptance and online payment, online communication, novelty search project task allocation, similarity detection, query export and statistics and so on. The extraction of power of attorney document content, online payment, and the similarity query of new power of attorney content were analysed detailly. After one year's trial operation, the system runed stably and responded quickly, and met the expected design requirements.

articleTitle: Dynamic identification method of insulation defects in distribution transformers based on continuous data visualization
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to realize the dynamic identification of insulation defects of distribution transformers with minimal errors, a method based on continuous data image is proposed to improve the accuracy of dynamic identification. The defect data is transformed into plane image structure data by continuous data imagery method, and input into convolution neural network to extract defect feature vectors. The feature vectors are input into the support vector machine classifier, and the training sample set is obtained by normalization. The linear and nonlinear classification results of samples are obtained after the training of vector machine, and the insulation defect recognition of distribution transformer is realized. The results show that when the number of iterations is more than 120 and the kernel function is 20, the method has the best effect and the accuracy is higher than 0.976, and the average accuracy is 0.9855, and the error is less than 0.15.

articleTitle: Semantic Matching Using an Efficient Multi-task Method
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Semantic matching is one of the most important tasks in natural language processing and plays a vital role in question answering systems, dialogue systems, modern search engines, and business systems. However, semantic matching tasks usually face higher labeling costs and greater modeling difficulty. In this paper, we propose a multi-task learning method that can easily introduce external annotated data while efficiently modeling the correlations and differences between different tasks. In more detail, we propose a task-aware attention mechanism to learn differential representations of a sentence under various tasks. At the meantime, we propose a multi-expert network to learn the commonalities and differences among different tasks. Experimental results on the benchmark dataset Chinese-Glue demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms existing methods.

articleTitle: Visualization system of regional protection action signal of distribution network considering flexible DC device
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to improve the convenience of detection of regional protection action signal in distribution network, a visualization system of regional protection action signal of distribution network considering flexible DC device is proposed. The signal acquisition model of regional protection action in distribution network is constructed, and the signal feature decomposition is realized by using the method of serial parallel integrated learning. Combining with the load forecasting and the output active power compensation method of the flexible DC device, the spectrum characteristic quantity of the signal is extracted. The spectrum analysis method is used to visually analyze and decompose the signal, and the flexible DC device and distribution are analyzed under the DC voltage time scale The associated information of regional protection action signal is reconstructed according to the signal three-dimensional spectrum to realize the visual system design of regional protection action signal in distribution network. The simulation results show that the method has high characteristic resolution and good static stability, which is convenient for the detection of distribution network regional protection action signal.

articleTitle: Simulation Design of Dynamic Visualization System Based on Wind Power Station
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: A visualization system for dynamic offshore wind farms based on the data fusion method is designed to obtain a good visual effect of wind farms. Import the windmill model and geographic matrix model into the Unity3D game engine, and achieve the real-time dynamic data communication between the Unity3D client terminal and the server through PhotonServer. An offshore wind power station in the Leizhou Peninsula is selected as the experimental object. The reconstruction simulation results show that the dynamic visualization system performs real-time 3D reconstruction of the wind power station at a very low cost and achieves sound visual effects.

articleTitle: Firmware and software design of data acquisition in digital BPM processor for SHINE
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: SHINE is the first hard X-ray FEL light source in China. A new digital BPM (Beam Position Monitor) processor has been developed to meet the requirements of SHINE. We designed a firmware and software structure based on the digital BPM processor to achieve the functionality of data acquisition. The digitized data from ADCs could be received, buffered, and stored in the DDR memory and the SD card. The sampling rate could be configured while the digital BPM processor is running. The firmware and software structure has been used in the hardware performance tests, which verifies the functionality of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Seam Welding Recognition Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In response to the problem of unsatisfactory recognition and positioning of material seam welding caused by changes in illumination, an image processing-based seam welding recognition method is proposed, through the steps of image feature extraction, improved BP seam welding and non-seam welding image classification, seam welding image recognition and positioning, etc. MATLAB simulation shows that the image processing-based seam proposed in this study welding recognition method can be effectively identified in different lighting conditions to locate the seam welding of steel pipe material, and the detection rate with overlap recognition reached 91.5%, with a false alarm rate of 7.2%, and the detection rate without overlap recognition was 86.3%, with a false alarm rate of 4.3%. Compared with the traditional ostu identification, this study method has higher detection rate and better performance.

articleTitle: Design of non-contact dynamic characteristic test system for frame circuit breaker
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The dynamic characteristics of frame circuit breaker directly affect its operation reliability. It is of great significance to realize the self-diagnosis of circuit breaker working performance by detecting the dynamic characteristics within the service life of frame circuit breaker. The closing and opening dynamic process of circuit breaker is taken as the research target. Based on the principle of dynamic characteristic test, the dynamic process detection is realized by using the identification method of rotating shaft displacement characteristics, and the experimental test data is compared with the actual data. The research results provide a new idea for realizing the self-diagnosis of circuit breaker operation process.

articleTitle: Data Mining and Analysis of Large-Scale Cross-Sea Bridge Construction Management based on Digital Management Platform
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the promotion of Industry 4.0 in the field of civil engineering construction management, the digitalization level of Chinese highway construction industry has gradually improved. However, a large amount of business data accumulated by highway engineering projects has not been effectively mined and utilized. This paper established a framework for business data mining and analysis based on a large-scale cross-sea bridge construction project, the Huangmaohai Link Project. Based on the project management framework, this paper conducts data analysis in project progress management, daily work management and project approval management. The analysis results effectively exposed the shortcomings and hidden problems in the project. The quality and efficiency of the management has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Convolutional neural recommendation network based on attention mechanism
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Feature extraction and interaction has always been a concern in the field of recommendation system, but the input of previous models is often difficult to take into account the user's historical behavior and attribute features. This paper mainly studies the implementation of collaborative filtering algorithm through convolutional neural network. The whole network is based on deep and wide structure. It mainly studies the characteristics of user portrait and historical behavior and introduces the attention mechanism to combine the two. Secondly, the wide-structured network can accept more input information, and the designed network can also learn the item information related to the user to be recommended at the same time to improve the accuracy of the recommendation. Moreover, the input of the user and item characteristics of the entire network is processed according to field division, which can absorb more characteristic information while reducing the amount of irrelevant training parameters and improving training efficiency. The output of the final network is a classification result, according to user information and item characteristics to infer the user’s preference for the specified item. And this paper also proposes an update method of user interest label decayed with time to dynamically update the user’s interest changes. By comparing with other advanced models on several data sets, the dynamic recommendation model designed in this paper can appropriately alleviate the cold start problem of the recommendation system while meeting the recommendation requirements, increase the novelty and diversity of recommendation results, and improve users Satisfaction.

articleTitle: SSGAN: Image Generation from Freehand Scene Sketches
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the remarkable progress on deep CNNs, recent approaches have achieved certain success on image generation from scene-level freehand sketches. However, most of the researches adopt a two-staged way, that is, to generate the foreground and the background of the image respectively. In this paper, we propose a novel one-stage paradigm of GAN-based architecture, which named SSGAN for image generation using sketch-to-image directly. Moreover, we design a novel Semantic Fusion Module (SFM) for better learn the intermediate features. Extensive experiments on SketchyCOCO demonstrate that our proposed framework can obtain competitive performance compared with the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Speaker System Based On CLDNN Music Emotion Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In this paper, We have designed a speaker system that can automatically recognize the emotion of playing music. The core of the entire system is a music emotion recognition algorithm based on convolutional long short term memory deep neural network (CLDNN). In addition, We use the PMEmo emotional music dataset as the training data of the neural network, which contains 794 music clips and their corresponding emotional labels. The system proposed in this article runs on a hardware platform with Raspberry Pi 4b as the main controller. After we say the wake-up word "SNOW" to the speaker system, the system will automatically recognize the name of the song and play it. While playing the song, the mood of playing the music will be automatically recognized by CLDNN algorithm. According to different emotion categories, different lighting effects will be presented in the system lighting module composed of WS2812 lamp beads. The music emotion classification model that forms the core of the system is a deep neural network composed of CNN+LSTM+DNN. The input of the neural network is the MFCCs characteristics of music, and the output is the music emotion coordinates under the V-A coordinates. The recognition accuracy of the whole model is about 90%, which achieves an ideal effect.

articleTitle: Multi-Categories Images Super-Resolution via Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: For a long time, single image super-resolution (SISR) has been studied by many people as a downstream task in the field of computer vision. Among them, constitutional neural network (CNNs) based methods have achieved impressive performance. This kind of methods can accomplish the super-resolution task by learning the mapping relationship between high-resolution (HR) and low-resolution (LR) images. However, CNNs usually conducts training on a category of picture, and the category of images can be divided into cartoon picture, text picture and nature picture according to its own texture feature. As a result, the SR performance degrades obviously if the input image is inconsistent with the categories of the training image. The usual solutions to the above problems: a. Train a single model on multiple categories of images, b. Train different models for different categories and select them as needed. For first method, the model capacity is required to be large enough, but also the performance of model is balanced on multiple categories. In contrast, the second method is more consistent with the actual scene, but it needs to design and train different models for different image categories. On the one hand, it needs to consume huge computer resources, on the other hand, it lacks flexibility. In this paper, we present a multi-categories image super resolution network via contrastive learning (MCSR), which can adaptively adjust model parameters for category images, to further improve the performance in multi-category images without introducing additional resource consumption. We train and verify our experiments on public datasets, and our method has achieved some improvement compared with traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on the inflexion quantification model of network public opinion monitoring based on entropy weight method and TOPSIS algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to solve the quantitative problems of indicators such as the network public opinion heat, development trend and social strengthening effect of the self media platform network public opinion, which are concerned by the network public opinion supervision department. In this paper, based on the number of public opinion carriers, netizens' emotional tendency measurement, information content sensitivity measurement and other dynamic quantitative indicators, the index system of network public opinion inflection monitoring and early warning evaluation is established. Then, the entropy weight method and TOPSIS method are used to establish the network public opinion inflection quantitative model, and the calculation method of network public opinion monitoring inflection is given. The model described in this paper can effectively analyze the trend of Internet public opinion and provide decision support for the Internet public opinion supervision department.

articleTitle: Research on Single Player Strategy Selection of Crossing Desert Game Based on Dynamic Programming and Fuzzy Evaluation
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: "Crossing the Desert" is a game that combines survival challenges and benefits. In this paper, aiming at the daily schedule and resource allocation in the game, firstly, the discussion is divided into two categories: mining and non-mining, and the Floyd algorithm is used to calculate the shortest distance of mining, establish a dynamic programming model, and respectively solve the schemes with the most reserved funds. Next, this paper comprehensively evaluates all kinds of situations, establishes a fuzzy evaluation model, and standardizes the loss of money and survival first with Min-max standardization. By discussing three typical situations, it is concluded that general players should take the best plan to prepare food and water with two days of high temperature and one day of sunny days.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing IPA Users' Intention Based on UTAUT
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Considering the advent of the era of artificial intelligence, the acceptance and use of intelligent personal assistants has important theoretical and practical significance. Based on the integrated technology acceptance theory, this study analyzes the internal and external factors and the psychological mechanisms that influence the willingness and behavior of intelligent personal assistant users, and the study also empirically analysis 374 users as samples. The results show that performance expectation, effort expectation, and hedonic motivation have significant positive effects on users' willingness to use intelligent personal assistants. Facilitating conditions have a significant positive effect on the willingness and behavior of users’ use of intelligent personal assistants, and users' willingness to use intelligent personal assistants has a significant positive impact on their use behavior.

articleTitle: Estimation Strategy of Hazardous Gas Source Term Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Hazardous chemical gas leakage accidents occur from time to time in the chemical industry, which has a serious impact on the public and the environment. Therefore, accurately determining the location and strength of leakage source is the key to deal with leakage accidents. Genetic algorithm is often used to estimate the source term information of gas leak-age accidents, but it has the phenomenon of premature convergence, so it is often combined with other algorithms. Therefore, in order to overcome this problem, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed for source term estimation, which can obtain more accurate source term information in a short time and play a data support role for emergency res-cue after an accident.

articleTitle: A cigarette package correlation system for Focke high-speed cigarette packaging equipment cigarette package correlation with grid code
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: According to different production speeds, cigarette packaging machines can be divided into low-speed, medium-speed and high-speed models. Different cigarette production speeds will also affect the collection speed and collection accuracy of the two-dimensional code of cigarette packaging. In this project, we propose a data collection and processing system based on the Focke FXS soft-pack high-speed model, and the system is verified in the actual production environment. In this project, the cigarette packages are printed with an industrial traceability code (in this project we use grid code for the cigarette package correlation test [1], grid code is an industrial-specific two-dimensional code technology, which is a very efficient dot code) as the unique identification of the cigarette packages. And the unique identification of the cigarette packages are collected by high-speed industrial cameras, which are then decoded and correlated in the background for the three kinds of cigarette packages(primary, secondary, tertiary packages). At the same time, a handheld PDA is provided to perform random inspection and verification of the correlated grid code information of the cigarette packages.

articleTitle: Automatic high-precision recognition method of planar coding grid for Camera Calibration
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to improve accuracy and efficiency of feature point extraction for camera calibration, a planar target is developed by combining a planar grid with three red positioning circle marks and displayed on the LCD. A new method is proposed to extract the nodes by utilizing the characteristics of cross neighbor area and combining with the sub-pixel extraction method. In the same time, a coding method is developed by constructing coding coordinate system and bidirectional stack structure to match the nodes on the images and object points. The proposed method is then applied to calibrate a nonmeasurement web-camera. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of feature points can be improved and accurate camera calibration can be acquired with the back-projection root mean square error (RMS) of the checkpoints in the images within 0.13 pixel. The method can also be extended to other automatic applications which adopt planar grid as the reference target.

articleTitle: Sparse Volume Rendering with Per-Pixel Linked List
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the improved capabilities in data acquisition, scientific visualization using volume rendering has to deal with more and more complex situations. These data contain fine and intricate structures with a large number of holes that pose huge challenges for efficient empty space skipping. Inspired by OIT (Order-Independent Transparency) algorithm, this paper proposes an object-order empty space skipping approach based on the per-pixel linked list. We innovatively combine the independent ray-casting of each volume brick with the OIT algorithm to achieve efficient rendering of sparse volume data. Experiments show our method has better performance than skipping all of the outer empty space via rasterization of tight-fitting bounding geometry.

articleTitle: Research on Mesoscopic Modeling Method of Composites Based on Particle Repulsion
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: According to the electromagnetic and structural mesoscopic finite element method (FEM), the method of generating mesoscopic geometry model based on particles repulsion is formed with calculation of vector introduced to deal with position and displacement of particles. Focusing on the configuration composed by particles without overlap, the models are generated by the algorithm, while the particle initial proportion and particle sizes are maintained. The interface program between the algorithm and the typical FEM software also developed to improve the practicability of the method. It is shown that this method, the three-dimensional mesoscopic geometry model and the FEM model of complex composites can be generated automatically.

articleTitle: Cyber-security risk management and control of electric power enterprise key information infrastructure
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Under the new situation of China's new infrastructure and digital transformation and upgrading, large IT companies such as the United States occupy the market of key information infrastructure components in important fields such as power and energy in China, which makes the risk of key information infrastructure in China's power enterprises become more and more prominent. In the power Internet of Things environment where everything is connected, the back doors and loopholes of basic software and hardware caused by the supply chain risks of key information infrastructure have broken through the foundation of power cyber-security and information security defense, and the security risk management of power key information infrastructure cyber-security has become urgent. Therefore, this paper studies the construction of the cyber-security management framework of key information infrastructure suitable for electric power enterprises, and defines the security risk assessment norms of each link of equipment access to the network. Implement the national cyber-security requirements, promote the cyber-security risk controllable assessment service of key information infrastructure, improve the security protection level of power grid information system from the source, and promote the construction and improvement of the network and information security system of power industry.

articleTitle: Step and repeat fabrication of large-area nanostructures on COC plastic substrates using thermal nanoimprint Lithography
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In this study, we proposed a method for thermal nanoimprint lithography on Cyclic Olefin Copolymer (COC) film substrate, and found the optimal experimental parameters such as imprinting pressure, holding time, and imprinting temperature. In addition, we focused on step and repeat thermal nanoimprint lithography (S&R T-NIL) on COC films to obtain large-area nanostructure patterns, by introducing a copper-based truncated square pyramid to achieve good resolution and then we conducted corresponding finite element analysis on the thermal field distribution of COC plastic substrates. The key operation of repeating nanoimprint is to find the optimal gap between each cycle, which can not only ensure the integrity of the pre-imprinted pattern, but also help improve production efficiency. Finally, this original method is used to deeply research step and repeat thermal nanoimprint lithography.

articleTitle: Perturbation-enhanced-based RoBERTa combined with BiLSTM model for Text classification
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Text classification is an essential task in the field of natural language processing, which aims to identify the most relevant category for a given piece of text. Although numerous methods of text classification have been proposed, there are still many difficulties such as metaphor expression, semantic diversity and grammatical specificity. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a new classification model F-Roberta-BilSTM. First, RoBERTa replaces the traditional static language model word2vec, which can dynamically adjust word vector features according to context information. Secondly, BiLSTM, composed of a forward LSTM and a backward LSTM, is added on the basis of RoBERTa, which helps to effectively extract semantic features according to forward context and backward context. Finally, we added noise disturbance to RoBERTa's word embedding layer to further improve the classification accuracy of the model, considering the impact of word vector feature accuracy on BiLSTM semantic feature extraction. The proposed model was validated on the two topic data sets (i.e., THUCNews and Shopping Review data sets) and achieved better performances than those of conventional classification models.

articleTitle: Research on Adjustment of FAST Active Reflector System Based on Rodriguez Formula
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Firstly, aiming at the establishment of the ideal paraboloid equation, this paper uses MATLAB and other software to fit the data to obtain the model in the reference state, establishes the rotating surface model of the working paraboloid in the lighting area, and determines the ideal paraboloid equation. Then, when the object to be measured is at a non-special angle, the model can be rotated to the ideal paraboloid. Through the intersection of the ideal paraboloid and the straight line and limiting the expansion range of the actuator, the new paraboloid equation can be obtained by MATLAB software, and then the position vector of the initial observed object can be obtained by Rodriguez's derivation model. Finally, according to the design principle of the celestial eye, the plane equation of the electromagnetic wave is obtained, and all the main cable points are substituted. It can be obtained that the acceptance ratio of the working paraboloid is 0.79 and the acceptance ratio of the original spherical surface is 0.022.

articleTitle: Research on the Expression mode of the Fusion of Virtual and Reality in Animation
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In the era of progressive multimedia Internet, many artists and scholars are constantly creating new artistic expressions, such as the performance art of the fusion of virtual and reality in animation. These new artistic expressions are generally due in the animation field with the progress of the times. This paper discusses the virtual elements in animated films, including the established scenes, designed roles, realistic factors and the structure of space-time dreamland. At the same time, it deeply discusses how to organically combine virtual elements and realistic images in film and television animation, and discusses the organic integration of virtual and reality in animation from the perspectives of virtual roles and virtual scenes, in order to provide reference for filmmakers to combine animation virtual and reality.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Martian Terrain Based on Dual-Branch
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the rapid development of computing, neural network technology has been widely used in various fields. Recently, the aerospace field has gradually become a symbol of scientific and technological progress in various countries. In the aerospace field, the autonomous movement of the planetary vehicle is the most important step in Mars exploration. How to accurately identify the planet’s topography is the main factor in the advancement of the planetary vehicle. The training of Mars terrain segmentation is inseparable from the labeling of Mars terrain and landforms. The labeling boundaries are often not very accurate due to various reasons. At the same time, the real terrain ground samples of Mars are extremely limited. These cause problems for the division of Mars terrain. In this paper, a dual-stream network is designed for the semantic segmentation of Martian terrain. One branch recognizes the accurately labeled internal area of the object, and one branch recognizes the inaccurate boundary area. The two work together to achieve a perfect Martian terrain segmentation. The scheme proposed in this paper is compared with the more popular U-net, etc., and our scheme shows superior performance.

articleTitle: Frontier and Prospect of energy conversion and storage of electric vehicles
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Over the past decade, people began to pay more and more attention to the emerging field of electric vehicles. As the development direction of future vehicles, in addition to the main advantages of environmental friendliness and fossil energy conservation, electric vehicles also have other unique application potentials, such as V2G technology. This paper explains, analyzes and compares the AC / DC charging technology through the first part; The second part compares the advantages and disadvantages of the existing main types of on-board batteries of electric vehicles, and introduces the latest research results; Through the third part, the principle of V2G technology is displayed and its application prospect is analyzed. Finally, it is concluded that DC charging pile may become the mainstream in the future, vehicle battery will be more efficient and environmentally friendly in the future, and V2G technology has great application prospects.
