This paper summarizes the recent breakthroughs in related fields, explains its basic concepts and principles, and puts forward some ideas for future development. Through this paper, readers can have a preliminary concept of the current situation and future development and application of key fields of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Design and application of power customer label application effect evaluation mechanism
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Customer tag is a way to know customers. It is a feature identification highly refined and summarized from data, which can support efficient decision-making. With the deepening application of customer labels in various businesses of power companies, how to realize the continuous optimization of inherent customer labels has become a difficulty. Focusing on the main line of power customer label operation evaluation analysis optimization, this paper constructs a single label application effectiveness evaluation system and label scenario application evaluation system, analyzes the existing labels based on the evaluation system, and establishes rule models and exception identification models such as label optimization recommendation, offline reminder, promotion reminder and exception monitoring based on the analysis. Effectively realize the systematization and scientific diagnosis of label application, and promote the comprehensive and efficient development of evaluation and construction.

articleTitle: Research on text similarity calculation based on BERT and Word2Vec
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: At present, the rapid development of NLP technology makes it more and more convenient in the direction of intelligent information retrieval and screening. The semantically based retrieval algorithm can effectively improve the retrieval rate by calculating the similarity between two sentences. This paper proposes a method to obtain the similarity between sentences based on Bert model, and compares the traditional ALBERT, ESIM and BIMPM models. Experimental results show that the accuracy of BERT model in calculating text similarity reaches 87%, which is obviously better than other models. At the same time, the synonym model is trained based on Word2Vec to obtain synonyms related to the target word. Therefore, the algorithm adopted in this paper can effectively improve the retrieval efficiency.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Analysis of Agricultural E-commerce Model based on F2B2C Mode
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: This paper explores the feasibility of F2B2C mode for new agricultural business entity, small-scale agricultural producers and consumers, builds an evolutionary game model for the two-sided market, analyzes the evolution process and stable trend of game-agent under dual relationship, and verifies the accuracy of game analysis results by MATLAB simulation. Finally, it is concluded that the implementation of F2B2C mode has strong feasibility under certain circumstances, which further lays a foundation for the feasibility of "Internet + ecological chain agriculture" model.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Cultivation System of Pleurotus Eryngii and Its Optimal Growth Light Formula
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Edible fungus is a rare food that integrates edible, medicinal and food therapy. With the further maturity of edible fungi factory production technology, the market scale of edible fungi is getting bigger and bigger. However, the facilities of the current edible fungi planting enterprises are generally relatively backward with shortcomings such as low yield, long growth cycle, and inability to guarantee quality. Therefore, it has become an important issue faced by all planting companies to increase the production of edible fungi, shorten its growth cycle and improve its quality. In this paper, taking the pleurotus eryngii in the edible fungi as an example, a set of Pleurotus eryngii intelligent cultivation system based on LED intelligent lighting has been completed. It can realize the intelligent adjustment of the illuminance, temperature, humidity and carbon dioxide concentration of Pleurotus eryngii. Through the experimental link, the effect of the system in increasing the yield of Pleurotus eryngii and optimizing the growth quality is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of China's hydrogen energy development prospects based on data research
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Hydrogen energy, for its advantages of zero carbon emission, high efficiency, and flexible application, has been a new solution to the dilemma between environmental protection and economic growth. In China, hydrogen energy has great potential in achieving the "carbon neutrality by 2060" issued in 2020. This paper starts with the applications of hydrogen energy, analyzes the current hydrogen energy utilization in China from the perspectives of FCEVs industry, microgrids construction and economic significance based on data research. Then, with reference to four mainstream hydrogen energy development patterns overseas, inspired ideas and suggestions for the hydrogen energy development in China are proposed to establish a clean, low-carbon, safe and efficient modern energy system.

articleTitle: Analysis of grid connection mode of smart grid with renewable energy
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the development of social economy and the continuous expansion of the scale of power grid, the disadvantages of traditional power grid increasingly appear. The vulnerability of traditional power grid has been exposed after several large-scale power outages occurred in the world. Therefore, the use of renewable energy supply has aroused people's attention. As a major premise of new energy industry, smart grid brings new possibilities for grid connection mode of renewable energy power generation. In the context of increasingly high carbon emission requirements, it is of great significance for the whole grid structure and environment whether the renewable energy power generation can work in the smart grid. Therefore, this paper analyzes the characteristics of grid connection of renewable energy generation, and introduces the advantages and disadvantages of integrating renewable energy generation into traditional power grid. Then the paper analyzes the situation and nature of smart grid, and according to the nature and development trend of smart grid, it also analyzes the advantages of integrating renewable energy into smart grid. The research in this paper lays a foundation for how to connect renewable energy generation to the power grid reasonably and effectively in the future, which is of great significance to the sustainable development of energy demand.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Wechat Mini Program Reservation System
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: This paper takes the B&B's reservation management system as an example, expounds the development idea of reservation system based on Wechat Mini Program, introduces recommendation algorithm of the product in detail; Wechat Mini Program developed by Wxml+Wxss+JavaScript as the front end for consumer use, The cloud development system based on node. js serves as a back end for managers to use, store system data through the database of Wechat cloud service, implement the design of reservation system, provides convenience for consumers, for the B&B industry has a positive impact.

articleTitle: Adaptive depth piecewise Algorithm Based on sediment classification for shallow water bathymetry by ICESat-2 and Sentinel-2
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Satellite derived bathymetry as a supplementary means of sonar measurement, plays an important role in the disputed islands and reefs. With the permeability of 532nm laser, ICESat-2 can provide a certain number of water depth control points for passive optical remote sensing satellite images, which can fill in the gap of shallow water depth data in disputed areas. However, due to the hardware conditions of ICESat-2, the major limitation for bathymetry is that ICESat-2 height profiles are inhomogeneously distributed in horizontal and vertical directions. Considering the influence of different sediments and depth ranges on the empirical model, an adaptive depth piecewise Algorithm Based on sediment classification (APBSC) is developed to estimate shallow water bathymetry. In this paper, APBSC and Log_ratio model are used to fit the spectral data with ICESat-2 height profiles. After water depth mapping using the trained model, independent ICESat- 2 point clouds from Quanfu Island and sonar measured depth from Ganquan Island are used to validate the Sentinel -2 derived bathymetry. The results show that the overall root means square errors (RMSE) for APBSC are 1.34m for Ganquan Island and 0.56m for Quanfu Island respectively. Compared with Log_ratio model, RMSE in Ganquan Island and Quanfu Island decreased by 0.08m and 0.1m respectively.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Construction of Green Building Pre-evaluation System Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: BIM technology can increase people's sense of visual impact, it can provide visual model, according to the accurate statistical content of parameters to build the model, so that people can see the model of the whole building, The final form presented to people is three-dimensional three-dimensional images. The suggestion of green building is based on the concept of environmental protection. The rational use of natural resources can make people live in harmony with nature. Based on this, we need to strengthen the construction of green building pre-evaluation system.

articleTitle: Research on side quality data fusion governance technology of smart meter manufacturers
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In this paper, the quality data of smart meter acquired by the acquisition device are analyzed, and the dirty data and useless data are processed; Data verification methods is designed to improve data availability; Multidimensional data fusion governance algorithm is designed to improve the effectiveness of data. The application of multi-dimensional quality data fusion governance technology verifies that the governance method can quickly, comprehensively and effectively verify the data quality of production enterprises, so as to ensure the validity and standardization of data, save labor costs, and finally support the construction of smart meter quality data service platform.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Text Sumarization Generation Method Based on ERNIE-GEN
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Chinese text summarization methods based on transfer learning suffer from insufficient deep information focus and exposure bias issue. This paper propose the ERNIE-GEN-CL method based on ERNIE-GEN, which introduces the continual learning mechanism and uses large chinese corpora for secondary training of the pre-trained model to achieve multi-layer focus of the model on lexical, syntactic and semantic information. the noise-aware generation method and the infilling generation mechanism are also used to optimise the exposure bias issue. Finally, for the text summarisation task, the pre-trained model was fine-tuned using the NLPCC2017 dataset, and and the experimental results verify that the method in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Innovative design of intelligent medical delivery robot based on FAHP and QFD
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to improve the use experience of intelligent medical delivery robot and improve the distribution efficiency. The FAHP and QFD integrated innovative design concept model is applied to the innovative design of intelligent medical delivery robot. FAHP is used to determine the weight of customer demand of QFD, and the design strategy is proposed by exploring customer core demand through QFD. By demonstrating the detailed design steps of intelligent medical delivery robot, the feasibility and effectiveness of this design mode are verified, providing new ideas for the innovative design of other products.

articleTitle: An effective method to reduce energy consumption in AGV dispatching system
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Automatic guided vehicles (AGVs) are widely used in automated manufacturing workshops. Efficient AGV scheduling can improve transportation efficiency and reduce cost. Recently, the energy consumption of AGVs is also receiving great attention. The goal of this paper is to obtain a solution that minimizes energy consumption. For this goal, a linear programming model with AGV load as a variable is established. A new method of determining speed is proposed to reduce the start-up energy. An improved discrete artificial bee colony algorithm (DABC) is proposed to get the better solution. Finally, the effectiveness of algorithm is proved through experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Ordering and Transportation of Raw Materials Based on TOPSIS Method and Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In the process of production, raw material guarantee plan provides favorable help for enterprise decision-making. In this paper, we mainly consider the ordering decision problem by data visualization and quantitative analysis. By constructing TOPSIS and multi-objective programming model, we can obtain the ordering and operation plan for the next 24 weeks. Firstly, the data are visualized and cleaned, and four evaluation indexes are constructed. According to these four evaluation indexes, the measurement system is constructed, and 50 suppliers that can guarantee the production are finally obtained by using TOPSIS evaluation model. Then we construct the target planning model by using the relevant indicators in the data. In the face of different requirements of raw materials for enterprise production, we use simulated annealing algorithm to get the most economical ordering scheme and the least loss transshipment scheme in the next 25 weeks. We transform the relationship between cost and materials, and finally get the transportation scheme with the lowest storage cost and the lowest loss.

articleTitle: Research on mobile network online education under the background of post epidemic Era – Based on the perspective of Chinese Art Curriculum
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The development of mobile network and intelligent terminal technology has laid the foundation for online learning. After the 2020 COVID-19, online learning mode of art courses has become an upsurge and trend in China's schools and training institutions. This paper discusses the strategies to further improve the online learning of art courses from three aspects: strengthening teachers' guidance to students' online learning, strengthening the cultivation of students' online learning concept and building a mixed learning model.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of landscape reconstruction based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a kind of three-dimensional visual technology, which can experience some functions more intuitively. This paper takes virtual reality technology as the carrier to explore the landscape system construction of the basic elements of garden landscape. Taking 3DS MAX and GIS system as an example, the basic scenes of landscape were established, such as building model scenes and plant model building scenes.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent shared laboratory based on three-tier architecture of iLab
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Through the research on the three-tier architecture of iLab and the Internet sharing technology, this paper realizes that teachers in the office or experimental classroom and students in the dormitory or home can have barrier free access to the real experimental equipment through the network, configure its parameters and issue commands, observe and obtain the experimental results, At the same time, it can also observe the status of hardware equipment in an all-round way (such as flashing light, alarm and connection). Furthermore, the sharing of laboratory resources and the exchange of experimental courses between different schools can be realized.

articleTitle: A New Method of Detect the Abnormal Electricity Consumption of Public Tranform Area
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In view of the actual situation that there are many users with both zero and low power in the public transformer area, a new method to detect the abnormal electricity consumption of this situation has been proposed to this paper. This method is based on Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD). In order to improve the efficiency of detection, the distance between the user powers sequence and the line loss powers time series were computed firstly to get the preliminary suspected users. After that, the time series of electricity consumption of these users and the line loss was decomposed adaptive by EMD method. By analyzing the change trend and correlation between high-frequency components obtained by EMD decomposition, the abnormal electricity consumption was calibrated. The test results of field cases indicate that the proposed method is effective against detecting the abnormal electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Rural household heating heat transfer enhancement device based on the principle of thermoelectric power generation
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: This project takes rural household heating and heating devices as the research object, and designs a system that uses thermoelectric power generation to enhance heat exchange. Through the layout and design of the thermoelectric power generation system and the layout and design of the heat exchange fans around the radiator, a trinity system is formed, and design temperature monitoring system, valve control system. Optimize system design for different modules, improve heat exchange efficiency, shorten heating time, and reduce natural gas consumption.

articleTitle: MDnT: A Multi-Scale Denoising Transformer Beyond Real Noisy Image Denoising
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Real noisy image denoising is a challenging low-level vision task that aims to remove noisy signals from degraded realworld images and recover original clean image. Recently, CNN-based and Transformer-based denoising researches have shown impressive results, however, most of the work neglect to capture the long-range dependencies, and the potential progressive relationships of hierarchical features. To address these issues simultaneously, we propose a multi-scale denoising Transformer (MDnT). Specifically, MDnT is mainly composed of stacked multi-scale residual Transformer blocks (MRTBs). MRTB enables the model to maintain spatial details from low-level features while capturing rich semantics from high-level features by constructing parallel multi-scale flows. Further, we introduce a multi-scale feature fusion layer (MFFL) to accomplish the information interaction between scales in order to enhance the richness of the learned representations. Extensive experiments are conducted on publicly real noise datasets for verification. The results show that our method achieves a competitive performance to state-of-the-art methods, while the total number of multiplyaccumulate operations can be reduced by up to 71%.

articleTitle: Research on Robust Segmentation and Fitting Method of NC Milling Cutter Image Contour
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In the process of NC machining, NC tools play an important role in the actual effect of workpiece machining. The actual size of NC tools directly affects the machining accuracy. Aiming at the problem of contour segmentation and fitting in milling cutter digital image measurement, a robust contour segmentation and fitting method is proposed in this paper. The contour is divided into several segments by iterative operation with the distance and the angle between adjacent segments as the judgment standard. The fitting method of line segments is determined by the included angle relationship between adjacent line segments and the length of line segments. Finally, the milling cutter contour is divided into line segments and arc segments to accurately complete the segmentation and fitting of the contour, which is not affected by the contour noise.

articleTitle: An Approach for Assigning Bug Reports Based on Developer Activities
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In software project development, bug assignment is an important part of bug repair work. Manual defect assignment is inefficient. Now researchers have proposed many classification techniques to automatically assign bugs, but most of the research work pays little attention to the developer’s active level. This paper proposes a bug assignment method considering the developer’s active level. Our method uses the recurrent neural networks to extract the developer’s active level features, combine convolutional neural networks and recurrent neural networks to extract text features of bug reports, and merges the two features for bug assignment. Experimental results on Eclipse and Mozilla data sets show that our method has higher accuracy compared to other methods.

articleTitle: Prefabricated construction engineering cost index compiled research based on multivariate linear regression
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Master the rule of the construction cost, achieve rapid estimation of project cost, is of great significance to the construction industry. For rapid development of prefabricated construction, practical and accurate engineering cost index system of construction is particularly important. In this article, through comprehensive analysis of a large number of literature, reference of foreign existing research results, combined with prefabricated construction characteristics and important influencing factors of cost, the index system suitable for prefabricated building appraisal, the multivariate linear regression model is established by SPSS software, and the influence of relevant factors on unilateral project cost is studied by testing the model and optimizing the model. By solving the model, the regression equation of the output, verify the rationality of the design of index system, so as to realize an accurate evaluation of the actual project cost.

articleTitle: Research on Pedestrian Detection Based on Improved YOLOv3
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The YOLOv3 algorithm is an anchor-based algorithm, which is difficult to cover all shapes of targets. It is often necessary to perform cluster analysis to determine the optimal anchors before training. These anchors have weak generalization performance and increase the complexity of detection. Cause the detection speed to slow down. Aiming at the different poses of pedestrians in pedestrian detection, the paper proposes an improved YOLOv3 algorithm for pedestrian detection. The anchor free method is used to cover all shapes of pedestrian poses, and the HSV data enhancement method is used to process the training images to improve the accuracy and speed of pedestrian detection. The experimental results show that compared with the original algorithm, in the INRIA pedestrian dataset and the Caltech pedestrian dataset, the improved algorithm in the article has increased accuracy by 9.23% and 5.01%. The speed has increased by 0.021 s and 0.025 s, respectively.

articleTitle: Effect of powder initial distribution on densification of Ti6A14V powder during hot isostatic pressing
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: A numerical model is established based on the plasticity theory to simulate the hot isostatic pressing (HIP) process considering the homogeneous powder distribution in the capsule and is then experimentally verified. In the numerical simulation, the initial relative density of the powder is subdivided into 4 gradients of 0.575, 0.625, 0.675 and 0.725, rather than generally used 0.65. The results show that different relative densities have a great influence on the final powder densification. The analysis of the numerical simulation results and the comparison with the experimental results indicate that the inhomogeneous distribution of initial powder density does exist in the actual experiment. For the capsule with large aspect ratio, this situation has a great influence, and the numerical simulation method considering this effect can reduce the relative error from 4.2% to 3.16%.

articleTitle: Adaptive fault estimation for descriptor systems with time-varying delays in Finite Time
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: This paper studies the problem of fast and accurate fault estimation for a class of descriptor systems with time-varying delays based on an adaptive finite time robust observer. This descriptor system is detectable, and time-varying delay is considered in finite time. Based on this model, the AFTRO is proposed. This observer has a non-singular structure which is easier to calculate, and by the adaptive algorithm, the fast fault estimation is implemented. Disturbance of the descriptor systems is considered, and finite time boundness of the observer is analyzed. Meanwhile, considering the accurate fault estimation, the robustness of the estimation error to the fault is guaranteed by H infinite technology in finite time. Sufficient conditions for the existence of the observer is proved, and using the LMI technology, the calculation of the constraint matrices of the observer is formulated as an optimization problem. Simulation example as three machine bus is given, and the simulation results are presented to illustrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Prototype Design of the Time Measurement Circuit for SiPM-based T0 Detector of CEE
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In Cooling Storage Ring (CSR) External-target Experiment (CEE), the T0 detector, based on plastic scintillator and SiPM, is located in the front portion of the beam target. It is designed to record the beam's arrival time and provide the start time to the other detectors. In this paper, a prototype design of the readout electronics system for the T0 detector is presented. This design aims to reach a high precision time measurement and requires a resolution under 50 ps RMS each channel for the whole system — the combination of T0 detectors and readout electronics system. To achieve high precision time measurement, a circuit divided into two parts is implemented — the pre-amplification and discrimination circuit based on NINO chip and the circuit that realizes Time-to-Digital Converter (TDC) based on FPGA. Meanwhile, the temperature compensation circuit for the SiPMs is implemented to eliminate the temperature drift by altering the operating voltage (Vop) of the SiPM. By conducting a series of tests to evaluate the performance of this prototype circuit, the function has been proven to be successful with a resolution of the readout electronic system better than 15 ps RMS within the dynamic range of detector output signals. A high resolution of voltage adjustment can be made using the temperature compensation circuits.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Cloud-Based Psychological Health Service Platform
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The lifetime prevalence of mental illness is 16.6% in China [1]. The public knows little about psychological knowledge and mental illnesses that mental institutions are good at treating. In addition, information is not communicated among psychological institutions. Therefore, this paper proposes a cloud-based multi-tenant mental health service platform. The platform serves for psychological institutions and common users. Psychological institutions enter the platform to provide psychological counseling services and share patient information; common users can choose suitable psychological institutions and counselors to conduct psychological counseling and learn relevant psychological knowledge when visiting the platform. The system is implemented using SpringCloud and Vue technologies. Once the platform is built, it will be deployed to the cloud. The design of the system can maximize the integration of mental health services resources to achieve patient information sharing, while breaking space barriers, so that mental health services benefit more people.

articleTitle: Study on Relationship Between Emotional Labor and Job Performance of Employees in Automobile Manufacturing Based on Multi-level Regression Model
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In recent years, emotional labor in organizations has become the focus of managers and researchers. The emotional feeling and expression of organization members will have an impact on the attitude and behavior of members, and then affect the survival and development of enterprises. This paper adopts the methods of theoretical research and empirical research, and uses the method of multi-level regression analysis to establish a cross-level impact model to explore the relationship and impact mechanism between leaders' emotional labor, employees' emotional state and job performance of employees in automobile manufacturing. Through the cross-level analysis of the survey data, it is concluded that the shallow leader behavior has a negative impact on employee job performance, and the deep leader behavior and real emotional expression has a positive impact on employee job performance. It also shows that employees' emotional state will have an impact on job performance.

articleTitle: Multi-level Distance Metric Learning for Few-shot Spoken term classification
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Spoken term classification has attracted great attention of researchers because of its wide application in real life. Traditional methods use a deep neural network trained with tremendous samples to classify a particular keyword which may not be applicable in case of insufficient samples and restrict the system from recognizing new or user-defined keywords. Few-shot learning algorithm is then applied to this speech task since it can use only a few examples to adapt to classifying new classes. Metric learning for few-shot learning aims to learn a metric in episode learning such that the distance between the positive pair of each episode is closed and the distance between the negative pair of each episode is far away. However, due to various pronunciation, speed or intonation, some spoken samples may be extremely dissimilar to its positive sample, but very similar to its negative sample, leading these samples to be ignored or overly influenced in metric learning. Therefore, to cope with this problem we propose a multi-level distance regularized metric learning method for few-shot spoken term classification. It explicitly disturbs a learning procedure by regularizing pairwise distances between embedding vectors into multiple levels. In this way, the degree of similarity between a pair can be fully utilized and the importance of each sample in metric learning is considered in a balanced manner. Multi-level Distance Regularization with simple Prototypical Network achieves the state-of-the-art performance in benchmark dataset: Google Speech Commands dataset.

articleTitle: Continuous Sign Language Recognition Using Multiple Feature Points
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Recently, most continuous sign language recognition methods use images as input, which leads to the problems of partial occlusion and information redundancy. In addition, positional information and non-manual information such as facial expression has not been well used in continuous sign language recognition. To solve these problems, this paper uses the human pose recognition model to identify the points of body, hands and face. Based on these key points, the residual spatial temporal adaptive graph convolutional network (RST-AGCN) is designed to extract the features of joints and bones, which can capture the location of hands relative to other parts and reduce the over-smooth of information. In the process of transforming features into sentences, this paper proposes a bidirectional GRU codec network based on attention mechanism combined with beam search strategy, and optimizes the mapping between features, glosses and sentences by using the joint loss of connectionist temporal classification (CTC) and attention. Finally, the whole model is verified on CSL corpus and PHOENIX-2014 corpus, which further proves that this method has a certain contribution to continuous sign language recognition.

articleTitle: Research on Space Rapid Response Launch Command
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Space rapid response launch command is based on shared information infrastructure to support commanders and their command organs to master and control the launch force actions and launch equipment status. The key and difficult problems are the efficient establishment of command structure and efficient use of command means. Through the research on the command of space rapid response launch, this paper has proposed the command structure that conforms to the law of force application, the command process that adapts to the level of launch mission, and the command communication mode with the lowest guarantee conditions, which can guarantee the efficient construction and operation of the command system of space rapid response launch, and provide effective and useful command means for the implementation of space rapid response launch.

articleTitle: Research on the new mode of environmental accounting information disclosure aided by “blockchain + government” – taking hashing algorithm as an example
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous growth of China's economy, a series of environmental problems have come one after another. Therefore, it is particularly important to study the environmental information disclosure level of China's listed companies. By analyzing the current situation of environmental accounting information disclosure, this paper points out the deficiency of government supervision. As the bottom layer of Bitcoin, blockchain technology is essentially characterized by decentralization, which can ensure that data is open and transparent and historical transaction records cannot be tampered with, thus increasing data security to a certain extent. "Blockchain + government" carries out internal and external collaborative supervision, uses hash algorithm to improve the security of data, and jointly contributes to the new mode of environmental accounting information disclosure mode.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Classification Trash Bin Based on Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low automation level, inaccurate classification and long time consumption of garbage classification, this paper puts forward the design of intelligent classification trash can based on speech recognition. In this design, STM32 is used as the main control chip, the voice recognition module LD3320 is used to obtain information, the stepping motor is controlled to realize the throwing of corresponding garbage, the infrared ranging module is used to monitor the capacity of the garbage can in real time, and the voice broadcast module and indicator light are used to remind when the garbage can is full. The experimental results show that the system improves the intelligence of garbage classification and effectively improves the accuracy and efficiency of garbage classification.

articleTitle: Intelligent Home Energy Efficiency Optimization Management Method Based on Demand-side Response
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to reduce the cost of home electricity consumption, this paper will promote the friendly interaction between users and the power grid to optimize the user-side resource allocation and realize the low-carbon and efficient electricity consumption. To a certain extent, it will further promote the development of energy conservation and emission reduction work and demand response undertakings. This paper studies the smart home energy optimization management strategies involved in the demand response. It introduces the energy load characteristics of the intelligent family, the demand response implementation mode analysis of the intelligent family, and the demand response model of the intelligent family. The research in this paper is of great significance to the demand side response of users, and lays a foundation for the energy efficiency optimization of smart home.

articleTitle: Fast jaw segmentation from CBCT images using level-set geodesic flow with implicit shape prior
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: For the treatment planning of the patients with craniomaxillofacial deformities, cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used and jaw segmentation can provide spatial orientation of jaw bones. On the other hand, jaw segmentation is an integral part of CBCT analysis. Therefore, it is necessary to develop a fast and accurate jaw segmentation method. In this paper, the CBCT dataset is segmented by using a thresholding method and then a novel level-set method. Our level-set formulation incorporates a modified geodesic active contour energy and a novel implicit shape prior energy. In the experiment, our proposed method was evaluated and compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) jaw segmentation method. These comparisons showed that our method is robust, accurate, efficient, and outperformed the SOTA method. Specifically, our average computing time for one CBCT dataset is only 3.15 seconds, 138 times faster than the SOTA method.

articleTitle: Forest fire prediction model based on Improved BP neural network
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Forest fire is destructive and difficult to deal with. To effectively prevent forest fire, it is necessary to establish a reliable prediction model. In this paper, based on BP neural network, a prediction model of the number of forest disasters in Alberta Province is established by selecting more appropriate meteorological conditions as characteristic factors and optimizing the structure of the neural network, so as to better predict the occurrence of forest fires and reduce the risk of fire.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on 1D-CNN-LSTM-TL
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The traditional rolling bearing fault diagnosis method has weak feature extraction ability, less labeled sample data in the actual working environment, and poor generalization of robustness after using transfer learning. Therefore, this paper proposes a bearing fault diagnosis model based on a One-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Transfer Learning. The model uses a convolutional neural network to extract features of rolling bearing data and combines an LSTM layer to process the time series features of rolling bearing data. Finally transfer this fault diagnosis model to other fault diagnosis systems through migration learning without freezing any parameters. This paper uses 1D-CNN, 1D-CNN-LSTM, and 1D-CNN-LSTM-TL models to classify and recognize four different working states of rolling bearings. The results show that the model proposed in this paper has strong robustness and generalization.

articleTitle: A proposed independence index for solving overlapped influence of multiple indicators in evaluation of HRRP recognition methods
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In the process of using multiple indicators to evaluate recognition methods, because of the phenomenon of overlapped influence of different indicators on evaluation results, it is necessary to concern the independence of the indicators which have strong correlation with each other. A method for decreasing cross impact that mean SNR and number of the samples, as evaluation indicators, have on the quality of data set is proposed. Given frequently-used HRRP recognition methods, the independence index is defined by the area below the fitting curve obtained from the quality of data set and correct recognition rate. In the evaluation process, this new index is substituted for mean SNR and number of the samples to give a more accurate result. To verify the validity and feasibility of the proposed method, a simulated HRRP data set and four HRRP recognition algorithms were taken to make an experiment. The results show that this method effectively make the evaluation process not affected by the change of data set.

articleTitle: Development and Design of Semiconductor Numerical Computing Software Based on Monte Carlo and Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The main work of this paper is to combine the advantages of Finite Element Method (FEM) and Monte Carlo (MC) method in semiconductor numerical modeling and calculation, and develop and design a semiconductor numerical calculation software based on the combination of FEM and MC method. It mainly includes a complete set of semiconductor numerical calculation tools, such as mesh discrete module, partial differential equation (PDE) module, MC module and visualization (VTK) module. Different from the general MC method, the Poisson equation coupling solution module in the MC method is solved by the FEM, which can adapt to various irregular discrete calculations. The device discretization can be optimized according to the actual needs, so that relatively accurate calculation results can be obtained while consuming less resources.

articleTitle: Discrimination method of crystal precipitation based on improved connected domain algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: It is difficult to distinguish whether there are precipitated crystals in the evaporating dish in the evaporation crystallization chemistry experiment of middle school via video. Firstly, this paper uses CLAHE algorithm to enhance the gray image of the original image. On this basis, an improved connected domain algorithm is proposed to enhance the roughness of crystal particle size, combined with the texture measurement algorithm of gray level co-occurrence matrix, a crystal precipitation discrimination algorithm based on connected domain roughness enhancement is proposed. The algorithm is tested on the real-time experimental video of middle school students, and the results have a high recognition rate, which verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Unique signal group selection method based on grey relational analysis and hierarchical clustering
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Unique signal often serves as high-consequence system protects password to use. In order to avoid the potential risk of mutual interference caused by using multiple unique signals simultaneously, it is necessary to select the group composed of multiple unique signals with the least similarity among them. In this paper, the data set based on the structure of unique signal is clustered by partition clustering, and the linear complexity and run distribution of the properties of unique signals are analyzed. Then the grey relational analysis method is used to combine the initial clustering results with attributes of unique signals, adjust the weight of each attribute in the whole, and reconstruct the data set based on attributes of unique signals. Finally, the hierarchical clustering method is used to cluster the new data sets, and the better grouping result is obtained, which reduces the potential risk of using multiple unique signals simultaneously.

articleTitle: An intelligent medicine delivery trolley
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to realize the intelligent management of hospitals, it solves the problems of low efficiency and waste of labor resources in traditional manual delivery methods. This paper designs an intelligent medicine delivery car system with STM32F1 as the main control chip, including camera module, motor drive module, loading and unloading detection module, Bluetooth communication module and LED indicator module. OpenMV is used as the visual processor to identify the ward number, and the line can be tracked through the gray-scale tracking sensor, and different paths between the pharmacy and the ward can be planned, which can be adapted to different hospital corridor environments. Choosing the corresponding route can quickly and accurately deliver the medicine to the corresponding ward. The limit switch is used as drug loading detection, and Bluetooth is used as wireless communication to build a communication bridge between two smart drug delivery vehicles to realize the coordinated drug delivery function of the two vehicles. The experimental results show that the intelligent medicine delivery car can realize the medicine distribution operation of hospital pharmacies and wards, can greatly improve the efficiency of medicine delivery, and has the advantages of high response rate, sustainable work and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Vehicle Lane-changing Trajectory Prediction Based on Interactive Multiple Model
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: This study aims to improve the accuracy of trajectory prediction in lane-changing scenarios compared to the state-of-the-art. Lane-changing trajectory prediction is critical for autonomous vehicle driving safety in the complex traffic environment. This paper proposed a novel vehicle lane-changing prediction method by combining kinematics and data-driven-based methods in an interactive framework. Firstly, a kinematics-based prediction method, Constant Angle Rate and Velocity Model (CTRV), and a data-driven prediction method, Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) are systematically compared. It is demonstrated that CTRV is difficult to capture long-horizon lane-changing dynamics, and generates the results in low accuracy. On the contrary, LSTM performs better in lane-changing long-horizon scenarios, but worse in short-horizon scenarios, due to the difficulty of precise fitting in data-driven architecture. In this case, we construct a novel interactive multi-model (IMM) trajectory prediction method that combines the above two prediction models. This method successfully captures the short-horizon and long-horizon vehicle lane-changing dynamics and improves the prediction accuracy greatly. Public dataset NGSIM I-80 is adopted for simulation and validation. Results show that the IMM-based approach reduced the lane-changing trajectory prediction error by 3% at least compared to LSTM methods.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Retinex Image Enhancement Algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In this paper, a brightness adaptive Retinex algorithm based on visual characteristics is proposed to enhance low-quality images. On the basis of MSRCR algorithm, this method uses bilateral filtering instead of Gaussian filtering. By nonlinear combination of spatial proximity and gray similarity, we can not only get the smoothed image after denoising, but also keep the details of the image edge, thus overcoming the image edge blur problem caused by linear filtering. The experimental results show that the algorithm can not only improve the influence of uneven illumination on the image, but also enhance the color and contrast of the image. At the same time, it also retains the edge information and details of the image, highlights the characteristics of defects and enhances the image quality.

articleTitle: Research on Problems and Solutions in Electronic Components Testing
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Electrical components are the most basic unit in electronic products, and different types of electronic products can perform different functions. When we use different electronic products, it is the electronic components with different functions that play a role. Artificial intelligence products, voice-activated products, etc. that are often used in our lives are achieved by electronic components. In order to ensure the performance of various products, we need to pay attention to the detection of electronic components. This paper discusses the problems and solutions in the detection of electronic components. From a microscopic point of view, there are hundreds of electronic components inside an electronic device. Different types of components play different roles. By combining them, they can achieve their functions and ensure the stability of the equipment system. run. Through the analysis of the composition of electronic equipment, we can know that only each electronic component can perform its function stably to ensure the normal operation of the system; when the operation of the equipment system fails, it is necessary to check the electronic components to find out the crux. It can be seen that the detection of electronic components has become particularly important. It can not only speed up troubleshooting, but also prevent hidden faults in operation and provide guarantees for the normal operation of the system.

articleTitle: A fluorescent reflectance model for seawater with spilt oil
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Study on Bispectral Bidirectional Reflectance and Reradiation Distribution Function (bispectral BRRDF) of seawater with spilt oil will provide a theoretical basis for oil detection, which will be of great significance for protection of marine environment and marine ecological balance. In this paper, a fluorescent reflectance model of seawater with spilt oil is described using the Monte Carlo method. The simulation results of bispectral BRRDF for seawater polluted with oil film and oil emulsion are presented. Angular dependences of fluorescence at wavelength of 355nm, 470nm and 365nm are discussed.

articleTitle: Construction of 540° Panoramic Image of Vehicles Based on Video Spatiotemporal Sequence Stitching
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: There are not only visual blind spots such as the front, rear, and A-pillars of the vehicle during driving, but also the environment under the vehicle chassis is also important for driving safety. Aiming at the problem that the traditional Around View Monitor (AVM) system only displays the environmental information around the vehicle body, a 540deg AVM system based on video spatiotemporal sequence image stitching is proposed. This paper aims to reproduce and display the blind spots around and at the bottom of the vehicle, based on image processing methods such as camera calibration, image registration fusion, and video sequence stitching. First, a group of fisheye cameras and wheel speed sensors are installed on the vehicle, and the perspective transformation matrix is calculated by calibrating the camera parameters and the relative position relationship of each camera, and then the original image is converted into a bird's-eye view. Then, the 360deg and 180deg panorama images are obtained by image stitching and fusion using the spatial relative position relationship of multiple cameras and video sequences at different moments from the same camera. Finally, the two are fused again to obtain a 540deg panoramic image. The experimental results show that the method can effectively eliminate the visual blind spot, display the surrounding environment of the vehicle without dead angle, and improve the driving safety.

articleTitle: Experimental study on echo characteristics of shallow water targets
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The increasing demand for underwater terrain and obstacle detection in nearshore shallow water poses a new challenge to the existing detection technology. Acoustic detection technology is the most mature technical means to realize underwater detection. Acoustic system has a long detection distance and is conducive to multi-target identification. It is an effective way to detect, classify and identify specific shallow water obstacles. Aiming at typical shallow water obstacle targets, experimental research on echo characteristics, target recognition and location technology of targets in shallow water channel environment is carried out. Through the research work of this project, this paper explores the application mode of acoustic imaging method in shallow water terrain and ground object detection.

articleTitle: Amazon EC2 Spot Price Prediction Using Temporal Convolution Network
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Cloud service providers sell some idle resources at dynamic prices. These resources are called spot instances. The price of Spot instances is affected by the relationship between market supply and demand. Generally speaking, the price of spot instances is much lower than that of on-demand instances or reserved instances. The prediction problem of spot instances is very important for users. Being able to predict the price with high precision can enable users optimize their bid of spot instances so that they can run their tasks more economically. Cloud service providers will not announce their specific pricing mechanism, but AWS will give the historical price of spot instances in the past 90 days. By transforming the price prediction problem into a sequence data analysis problem, we can use the TCN(temporal convolution network) to predict the future price. The experimental results show that the TCN prediction model outperforms the traditional machine learning model and other models such as CNN and LSTM in MAE, MAPE and RMSE.

articleTitle: Short-term power load forecasting based on BP neural network optimized by genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Accurate short-term power load forecasting is of great significance to the safe operation of power systems. Aiming at the defects of traditional BP neural network that it is easy to fall into local optimization and low prediction accuracy, Proposed to optimize the BP neural network with genetic algorithm, To improve the initial weights and thresholds of the network, increase the convergence speed, And then establish the genetic algorithm to optimize the prediction model of the BP neural network. The model uses one input, output layer, double hidden layers, Analyze and forecast the power load data of a company. Experiment simulation through matlab platform, The results show that the BP neural network model optimized by genetic algorithm has higher prediction accuracy, better stability, and more practical value.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality-based Emergency Robot Rescue Training Simulation System
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Power is the indispensable main energy and power in modern society and the power distribution room is the key place. If the power danger situation cannot be found in time and take counter measures, it will cause irreparable losses. With the development of robot and artificial intelligence technology, the emergency robot is widely used in field of rescue, and the operation training is particularly important. Virtual reality exercise is an efficient, flexible, and economical method. Through three-dimensional scene reconstruction of power distribution room, danger situation simulation, rescue path intelligent planning guidance, combining training and assessment, this paper discusses the method and application of constructing a rescue training simulation system, which provides theoretical support for emergency rescue strategy formulation and rescue personnel training and assessment.

articleTitle: Improved Flower Pollination Algorithm and its Application in Medical Image Registration
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor accuracy, easy to fall into local maximum and slow convergence in existing medical image registration method. Puts forward an improved flower pollination algorithm and in application in medical image registration, redefined the global and local pollination iterative formula of basic flower pollination algorithm, increased the diversity of population and the ability of local exploration, better balance the global search and local search of algorithm. Compared with the basic flower pollination algorithm, cuckoo search algorithm and Powell algorithm, Simulation experiments of different image sizes show that the improved flower pollination algorithm has good robustness and can accomplish the medical image registration task quickly and accurately. Moreover, the larger the image, the more obvious the advantage, providing a high efficiency and high precision method for medical image registration.

articleTitle: A novel mixed multi-index comprehensive evaluation method for HRRP recognition algorithms based on D-S evidence theory
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Though many multi-index comprehensive evaluation methods have been used to evaluate some HRRP recognition algorithm, sometimes they couldn’t give a completely consistent result because of their own focuses and restrictions. Therefore, in order to make results more objective and recognition methods more discriminating, it is proposed to regard the results from different single evaluation methods as evidence sources to improve the quality of evaluation result. The proposed mixed method calculates the dispersion degrees and the correlation coefficients for all the individual evaluation results, measuring result discrimination and consistence, to establish a probability distribution function denoting confidence and then employs D-S evidence theory to make an integration. For verification, four evaluation methods, weighted sum method, grey correlation analysis method, TOPSIS method and COPRAS method, were selected to evaluate four HRRP recognition algorithms. The results show that not only the correlation coefficient of the proposed mixed method is higher than the four singe methods but also the dispersion degree is the highest, which proved the superiority and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Quota Matching-based Task Offloading for WSN in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the development of the smart grid, massive sensors are deployed to collect data and offload them to edge gateways for processing. However, the task offloading optimization still faces several challenges such as differentiated quality of service (QoS) requirements, decision coupling among multiple sensors, and the impact of electromagnetic interference. In this paper, a low complexity task offloading algorithm based on quota matching is proposed for wireless sensor network (WSN). The joint optimization problem is transformed into a quota matching problem. Through continuous iteration, a stable matching between sensors and servers is established to improve the weighted difference of delay and energy efficiency. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated through simulations.

articleTitle: Dorsal Hand Veins Recognition Based on LogGabor Feature Sparse Representation and Classification
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Dorsal hand vein recognition is a biometric technology emerged in recent years. In this paper, we proposed to employ the LogGabor filter to extract multi-scale and multi-orientation information from near-infrared dorsal hand vein images. A multi-channel feature descriptor was constructed based on the sparse representation and dictionary learning. Then, a multitask sparse representation classifier was employed to classify and recognize the dorsal hand vein patterns. The proposed method was validated on the self-established dataset and two public datasets. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method can describe effectively the texture information, and recognize the patterns of dorsal hand veins with high accuracy. In addition, the computational efficiency can be improved effectively by adopting a fast filtering algorithm.

articleTitle: Subpixel Location Model Based on Lagrange Interpolation
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of electronic science and technology, image processing technology gradually tends to mature. The measurement of edge contour is more and more accurate. The image distortion correction technology also makes the image easier to process. This paper mainly uses HALCON and MATLAB to process the image and establishes models such as grey level optimization exposure repair, Lagrange interpolation method for sub-pixel edge detection, and image correction according to the coordinate system. The established model method is used to study the problem.

articleTitle: Learning Personalized End-to-End Task-Oriented Dialog Agent in Low Resource Scenarios
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Learning personalized dialog systems is an interesting topic, as the personalized agents can better perceive the dialog contents and thus improve the communication efficiency. As for the retrieval-based dialog systems, existing personalized variant selects correct responses according to the persona labels collected manually. However, when few samples are obtained, the personalized agents can maintain the original performance. To fill this gap, we propose to apply MAML and its variants to train task-oriented dialogue model, in order to transfer to arbitrary persona by learning few samples. We implement the proposed models on the personalized bAbI dataset, and the experimental results validate the effectiveness of our solution.

articleTitle: Application of PLC-based servo control system in UAV station
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: With the progress of the times and the development of science and technology, the servo system is more and more popular and applied in various occasions. The UAV base station has developed rapidly in recent years. The lifting of the shutdown platform and the opening and closing of the door of the UAV base station are inseparable from the servo motion control system. This article will introduce a Delta B2 based on Siemens 200 smart PLC. The servo motor has a motion control system controlled by a screw rod, and the servo motor can be precisely controlled through an external touch screen. The test results show that with the PLC programmable controller, the motion control has a high degree of accuracy, which can meet the requirements for the lifting of the shutdown platform and the opening and closing of the gate of the UAV base station.

articleTitle: Text Adversarial Generation Based on Latent Variable Models
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Variational auto-encoders (VAEs) have received much attention recently as an end-to-end architecture for text generation with latent variables. The variational auto-encoder model's encoder cannot fully extract the semantic information of text, which leads to the poor quality of text generation. A text adversarial generation model named VSGAN based on variational auto-encoder is proposed. VSGAN uses VAE to extract short-distance text features and long-distance text features, constructs fusion hidden variables after full connection, and generates text sequences by decoding fusion hidden variables. The intensive adversarial training method is introduced to improve the quality of text generation. Experimental results show that the accuracy and authenticity of the proposed model are further improved compared with the baseline model.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Single Event Transient Characteristics of Different Combinational Logic Cells with Nano-Scale FDSOI CMOS Process
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: This paper uses 3D TCAD simulation tool to study the single event transient (SET) characteristics of four types of logic cells (INVX2, NAND, NOR, INV_STACK) with nano-scale FDSOI CMOS process, and the influence of the LET value on the SET pulse width characteristics of the four cells. Simulation shows that when heavy ions strike NMOS, among the four cells, the NAND structure introduces the smallest amplitude and pulse width, while the NOR structure introduces the largest amplitude and pulse width. On the other hand, when PMOS is stricken, we got opposite results. In both cases, the INV_STACK structure has advantage in SET minimization. Based on the simulation results, it is indicated that the SET amplitude and pulse width of the four logic cells all increase with the LET value, while the increase rates decline with LET.

articleTitle: Application of virtual reality technology in competitive sports simulation
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Competitive sports is a sports activity with climbing technique and excellent performance as the main goal. Based on the application of virtual reality technology in competitive sports simulation, correlation analysis is made. Competitive sports are transformed into sports analysis system and simulation system by using virtual reality technology. Virtual reality technology uses computer to simulate the motion environment close to the real environment, so that users can deeply immerse themselves in the virtual scene and enhance their sense of experience. The motion analysis system will make a comprehensive analysis of all kinds of data information, motion state and duration in the process of motion. Simulation system is to build a virtual sports scene, people can simulate competitive sports through the virtual environment, fully enhance the user's virtual reality technology of reality experience.

articleTitle: Speaker Identification Via the Relation Network: a Meta-Learning Method
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Speaker identification(SI) can be categorized as closed-set and open-set according to the characteristics of data set. For the latter, the label space of the test phase and the training phase is disjoint. Essentially, this is a few-shot learning problem. In this study, spectrogram features are obtained from raw audio data, and a convolution-based speaker identification model is trained end-to-end by using spectrogram features within the framework of the relation network (RN), a metalearning based on the deep metric learning method. Our approach is validated on the VoxCeleb2 dataset, and compared with the model with prototypical network loss (PNL) which also leverages meta-learning for speaker identification, RN outperforms PNL and needs less data. In the absence of novel categories, the identification accuracy of the best-trained model can reach 85.44% when there are only 3 support samples in each category and 71.98% when there are only 1 support sample. In addition to demonstrating the effectiveness of this method, we also suggest possible directions for improvement.

articleTitle: Application of OverDrive software in F block
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Reservoir permeability has changed after long-term water injection development in Lamadian oilfield. A large amount of injected water is injected along the high permeability layer and ultra-high permeability layer for a long time, gradually forming inefficient and ineffective circulation, which seriously affects the oilfield development benefit. Therefore, this paper firstly uses the efficient identification and treatment system of invalid circulation field, and selects nine identification parameters to quickly identify invalid circulation well layer in F area. Secondly, through the analysis of the identification results, the macro distribution law of invalid cycle is summarized. Finally, combined with the types of invalid circulation, the corresponding adjustment countermeasures are formulated, and further determine the potential of ineffective circulation well treatment in the block. This study can effectively guide the development effect of water flooding in F zone by carrying out corresponding governance work.

articleTitle: Design of Table Tennis Picking and Serving Robot Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the existing table tennis server, such as immovability, single operation and inability to integrate serving and picking up the ball, this paper designs a table tennis picking up and serving robot. The image obtained by the camera is preprocessed by median filtering, corrosion expansion, image segmentation and Hough circle detection, etc., and the table tennis is identified and acquired by combining shape and color features. This paper puts forward a method of acquiring the depth information of table tennis based on camera angle feedback ranging, which can realize the positioning of table tennis accurately and efficiently. Experiments show that the robot can accurately and efficiently identify, locate, grab and serve table tennis in different environments.

articleTitle: Fusion Methods in Motor Imagery Classification
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Motor Imagery (MI) based Brain-Computer Interface system (BCI) has various applications including prosthesis control, virtual reality control, motor rehabilitation, etc. Yet, such systems still face many challenges such as low accuracy in MI classification. There has been a lot of research on improving motor imagery performance, but most of them focus on studying single signal or single technique. In this paper, we explore the feasibility of improving the accuracy using fusion methods. First, we will explain some terminology regarding to motor imagery and brain computer interface. Then, we will discuss several categories of fusion according to the level at which the fusion is conducted. Finally, we discuss different situations and different fusion methods specifically. This review summarizes typical technology and state-of-the-art progress in the fusion methods of motor imagery classification over the last decades.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Information Extraction Technology of 3D CAD Assembly Model Based on CATIA Secondary Development
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Aiming at the problems of incomplete information extraction and insufficient depth in the process of extracting the assembly feature information of aircraft and other assembly parts, a method of extracting the assembly feature information of complex products was proposed. The method takes CATIA software as the platform and adopted the secondary development of fast feature information extraction function. Combined with the binary tree pre-sequence traversal algorithm, depth first and layer by layer, the assembly information of multi-layer nested complex assembly can be extracted completely, and the feature information of complex product assembly can be fully utilized to more effectively support assembly process planning. In this paper, the feasibility of this method is verified by taking a conveyor of a certain civil aviation aircraft wing as an example.

articleTitle: Gas anomaly data detection based on hybrid neural network
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: The accurate measurement of gas flow is directly related to the economic benefits and social interests of gas enterprises. Moreover, as a kind of time-series data, there is a serious imbalance in the distribution of positive and negative samples in the data, which leads to low accuracy and difficulty in detecting gas anomaly data. To address these problems, a cost-sensitive hybrid network model is proposed in this paper. The model combines the stronger local feature learning ability of CNN network and the better sequence feature learning ability of GRU network, and then introduces a cost-sensitive loss function to solve the problem of inaccurate classification accuracy due to skewed data distribution. The experimental results show that using this model can find the outliers in the measurement data more accurately, which has some reference significance for the accurate measurement of traffic.

articleTitle: Secure network coding based on improved RSA
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the Key Distribution Center (KDC) is attacked when distributing the permutation key in incoherent network with a secure random linear network coding (RNLC), a secure scheme based on improved RSA is proposed. In the secure scheme, an improved RSA algorithm is used to encrypt the permutation key, and then the permutation step are improved to resist exhaustive search attacks. Simulation results show that compared with other schemes, this scheme has enhance data security with strong encryption performance and can resist eavesdropping attack effectively.

articleTitle: Strong Convective Weather Extrapolation Based on VAN-ConvLSTM
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: Strong convective weather forecasting is an extension of traditional weather forecasting. The accuracy of short-term forecasts of strong convective weather becomes particularly important in early warnings. However, existing forecasts of severe convective weather often have difficulty responding accurately and quickly to weather hazards, while predictions are relatively inaccurate. In this paper, we propose a deep learning model. The model mixes multilayer architectures, including a deep visual analog making network (VAN) and a convolutional long and short term memory network (ConvLSTM). We use ConvLSTM to process the spatial features of the temporal images, while adding VAN to perform image analogy on the single frame image passed into the network. With this method, a continuous image of the same spatial output can be obtained based on a time series. The experimental results show that the prediction model combining VAN and ConvLSTM proposed in this paper has better prediction performance than other existing methods.

articleTitle: A High Gain Multiband Dual-polarized Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: ICETIS 2022; 7th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science
abstract: In this study, a high gain multiband dual-polarized dipole antenna is proposed for 5G applications, which consists of a pair of ±45deg cross-dipoles, director and two inverted Gamma-shaped improved feeding structures. By adding the director, the peak gain of the antenna is approximately 7.58 dB, and the directional pattern is stronger. According to the simulated results, the bandwidth of port1 and port2 are 41.7% (3.13–4.78 GHz) and 38.2% (3.13–4.61 GHz), respectively. The port-to-port isolation can reach up to 22 dB.
